title: 第二十三章 暴富第二十四章 归来
content_zh:
柳辰看着被重新封起来的洞口，有点怀疑会不会被其他人发现。
尤其是山脉里的那几位一级妖兽，他们知道了沐雨柔的行踪，肯定知道她都去过哪里，想找到这里可谓易如反掌。
不过很快柳辰就自嘲的摇了摇头，心想自己真是瞎操心。
沐雨柔自然会处理好这些，自己一个低级武徒就是有心管也没这个实力啊。
“现在最主要的就是先回去，解决家族的困境，然后争取在最短时间内突破到正式武者的境界”
这是他目前最要紧的事。
家族的困境，对于现在的柳辰来说还真不叫事。
不管是战斧灵器还是傀儡兽都可以轻松解决。
反倒是短期内突破到正式武者境界有些困难。
哪怕有了这次的经历以及收获，柳辰对突破到正式武者也没有什么把握。
更何况柳辰定的目标是二十年内达成，这就更加困难了，至于为什么要卡这个时间。
那是因为在这个时间内突破成功他的容貌不会与现在相差太多。
毕竟他可不想等自己去找沐雨柔的时候是带着一副苍老的面孔去的。
到时候要真是那种情况他估计也就没脸去了，哪怕对方不介意。
他也不想被挂上个“老牛吃嫩草”
的标签，虽然沐雨柔的真实年龄要比自己大很多，但是人家看着年轻啊。
“看来离开鱼鳞岛的行程要加快了，时间不等人啊”
柳辰算了一下时间，估计后面二十年都有的忙了。
回去的路上并没有遇到厉害的妖兽，不知道是他的运气比较好还是这些妖兽得到了什么消息都藏了起来。
其实柳辰猜的没错，由于沐雨柔的到来，山脉深处的那几只一级妖兽给自己境内的低级妖兽都下了命令，这段时间不允许走出自己的领地，也不得对人类发起攻击。

毕竟一但不小心惹到那位姑奶奶牵连到自己，那可就倒霉了。
看看铁羽的遭遇就知道了，这位可不是好说话的主。
柳辰倒是对没有妖兽挑衅自己很不满意，他还想试试自己的新武器-星陨刀的威力呢，没有对手这还怎么试？
总不能自己主动去找妖兽吧，他还没那么无聊，再说他也没那个时间。
他算了一下自己已经在元妖山脉里呆了快半个月了，这段时间估计外面已经乱套了。
以他对父亲的了解，在得知自己被血杀围杀生死未知的时候，肯定会暴怒然后跟陈家开战。
“只希望自己回去的及时，可不要出什么变故啊”
柳辰还真担心，父亲在准备不足的情况下贸然开战。
一但损伤过大，元南郡绝对会元气大伤，到时就算有自己带回去的东西也很难挽回颓势。
毕竟战争不是光看高端战力的，军团作战也很重要。
没有足够的士兵，就算高端战力占点优势，也很难影响整个大局的。
除非有正式武者出手，但据柳辰所知已经有上百年没有听说过有正式武者出手的情况了，好像这等存在有什么禁忌一样。
现在战争出现的最高战力也就准武者层次。
由此也可以看出正式武者的实力有多么恐怖，足矣扭转一场战争的胜负，这也是被禁止出手的原因，实在任由他们随意插手凡俗战争，伤亡人数将会是一个恐怖的数字。
此时柳辰正坐在风豹傀儡上悠闲的吃着果子。
虽然没有遇到妖兽，但是还是有两只瞎眼的凶兽试图偷袭他。
content_en:
Liu Chen looked at the re-sealed cave entrance, a little doubtful whether it would be discovered by others.
Especially those first-level monsters in the mountains. They know Mu Yurou's whereabouts and must know where she has been. It is easy to find this place.
But soon Liu Chen shook his head mockingly, thinking that he was really worrying too much.
Mu Yurou will naturally be able to handle this well. Even if she is a low-level martial arts disciple, she doesn't have the strength to care.
"The most important thing now is to go back first, solve the family's dilemma, and then strive to break through to the realm of a formal warrior in the shortest possible time."
This is his most important thing right now.
The family's predicament is really nothing to Liu Chen now.
Whether it is a battle ax spiritual weapon or a puppet beast, it can be easily solved.
On the contrary, it is somewhat difficult to break through to the realm of a formal warrior in a short period of time.
Even with this experience and gains, Liu Chen was not sure about breaking through to become a formal warrior.
What's more, Liu Chen's goal is to achieve it within twenty years, which is even more difficult. As for why it is stuck at this time.
That's because if he succeeds in breaking through within this time, his appearance will not be much different from now.
After all, he didn't want to go with an old face when he went to find Mu Yurou.
If that were to happen, he would probably be embarrassed, even if the other party didn't mind.
He also doesn't want to be labeled as an "old cow eating young grass"
Although Mu Yurou's real age is much older than her, she looks young to others.
"It seems that the journey away from Fish Scale Island will be accelerated. Time waits for no one."
Liu Chen calculated the time and estimated that he would be busy in the next twenty years.
He didn't encounter any powerful monsters on the way back. I don't know if it was because he was lucky or because these monsters hid any information they got.
In fact, Liu Chen's guess was correct. Due to Mu Yurou's arrival, the first-level monsters deep in the mountains gave orders to the low-level monsters in their territory. During this period, they were not allowed to leave their territory or attack humans.
After all, if he accidentally offends that aunt and implicates himself, it will be unlucky.
Just look at Tie Yu's experience and you will know that this person is not easy to talk to.
Liu Chen was not satisfied with the lack of monsters to challenge him. He also wanted to try the power of his new weapon - the Star Meteor Knife. How could he try it without an opponent?
He can't take the initiative to find monsters by himself. He's not that bored yet, and besides, he doesn't have the time.
He calculated that he had been in the Yuanyao Mountains for almost half a month. During this time, things were probably in chaos outside.
Based on his understanding of his father, when he learned that he was surrounded by blood and his life and death were unknown, he would definitely be furious and start a war with the Chen family.
"I just hope that I can go back in time and nothing will happen."
Liu Chen was really worried that his father would start a war rashly without adequate preparation.
Once the damage is too great, Yuannan County will definitely be severely weakened, and even with the things he brought back, it will be difficult to restore the decline.
After all, war is not just about high-end combat power, legion combat is also very important.
Without enough soldiers, even if the high-end combat power has an advantage, it will be difficult to affect the overall situation.
Unless a formal warrior takes action, but as far as Liu Chen knows, there has been no case of a formal warrior taking action for hundreds of years, as if there is any taboo against such existence.
The highest combat power in the current war is at the warrior level.
From this we can also see how terrifying the strength of formal warriors is, which is enough to change the outcome of a war. This is also the reason why they are prohibited from taking action. If they are allowed to intervene in ordinary wars at will, the number of casualties will be a terrifying number.
At this time, Liu Chen was sitting on the Wind Leopard Puppet and eating fruit leisurely.
Although he didn't encounter any monsters, there were still two blind beasts trying to attack him.
